body:
## Description

Make the first Admin Quick start heading **Turn off direct internet access to AI Agents**. Its paragraph now says **Turn off direct web access to AI Agents, then connect Thermus for search and page retrieval.** Shared content updates the page and copied Markdown together; the canonical guide matches it.

## Review

**T0 Auto merge expected** — copy-only change in an internal web module; final committed-candidate classification is pending.

Architecture facts: none expected. Routes, authorization, provider controls, public declarations, dependencies, and all 20 registry views are unchanged. `.pr-impact.json` records all flags as false and `modelUpdated: false`. No diagram or L4 detail is needed. The generated metric record preserves the base analysis.

Merge status: **blocked** while the final Linux AMD64 image gate and committed-candidate review finish. Required human approval: none expected for T0.

Completed: 5,685 Node + 60 portal tests, typecheck, portal build, 14 focused cases, 2 browser cases, 11 self-hosted container cases, native hosted build, and verified unit + integration coverage. Hosted-live is N/A because authentication, WorkOS operations, and live tests are unchanged. The separate HTML mockup was updated outside the repository candidate.
